question: Should OpenClaw permanently support bundled Discord source-message subagent progress with seven configuration fields and a core channel lifecycle completion adapter?
rationale: This adds user-facing configuration and shared lifecycle/API surface; technical repair cannot decide whether these should become permanent supported contracts.

options.title: Sponsor after repair
options.body: Accept the bounded opt-in feature after both defects, restart documentation, upgrade review, and exact-head proof are complete.

options.title: Narrow the contract
options.body: Keep Discord rendering but reduce public configuration and shared lifecycle surface to a smaller generic typed API.

options.title: Decline the feature
options.body: Close the PR if bundled Discord subagent progress is not a supported permanent product direction.

recommendation.title: Sponsor after repair
recommendation.body: Accept the bounded opt-in feature after both defects, restart documentation, upgrade review, and exact-head proof are complete.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history owns the terminal lifecycle invariant most directly affected by the new completion adapter.
